Hi Ilan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to get the MSA + Order Form intake started so your onboarding team can begin testing integrations while we finish contracting. Initial asks below so Legal and Contracts can triage: 

- Which template does WaveLine prefer: Redwood standard MSA (template attached) or do you have a counterparty MSA you want us to review?
- Confirm billing entity and address for Exhibit A (we attached a blank ExhibitA_Billing.xlsx for your convenience).
- Any hosting/data residency constraints (EU/US/APAC regional requirements)?
- Who is the WaveLine signing authority (name, title, email)?

I've attached our standard MSA to speed review. If you prefer to send your redlines, please mark them as Word redlines or PDF annotations and include a brief note on any must-have changes. 

Attachments: [WaveLine_MSA_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)], [ExhibitA_Billing.xlsx (XLSX, 23KB)]

Proposed timeline from our side: initial read + intake by Contracts (2 business days), suggest redline sync if material changes are requested (30 min).

Thanks — Ilan, copying Kimberly and Marissa to own contracting and billing respectively.

--
David Kim
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks David — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers from our side: 

- We will start from Redwood's standard MSA and propose a few limited edits (mostly liability and data residency paragraphs).
- Billing entity is WaveLine Analytics, Inc.; billing address: 810 Market St, Suite 2200, San Francisco, CA 94103. Please populate Exhibit A accordingly.
- Data residency: for now we need US hosting only; we will flag EU residency if we expand next year.
- Signing authority: Mira Patel, VP Finance (mira@waveline.ai).

I've attached our initial redline draft (tracked changes) for section-level comments — these are just WaveLine's starting points, not final asks. If Redwood has standard language for SOC2/Security evidence we can consume that as part of intake.

Attachments: [WaveLine_Redlines_v1.docx (Word, 98KB)]

Can Kimberly advise on whether the edits below are likely to be fast triage items or will need escalation? If we need a 1:1 redline sync, we can do 10:00am PT tomorrow.

Best,

Thanks Ilan — copying a quick intake triage from Contracts so everyone is aligned.

Triage summary (Contracts):
1) Liability / Indemnity edits — likely material. We'll review in detail but expect these to require an exception memo if beyond our template thresholds.
2) Data residency (US only) — acceptable; note this for deployment config and Private/VPC options if they expand.
3) Billing entity/address — confirmed, Marissa will populate Exhibit A and provide invoice contact and tax info.
4) SOC2/security evidence — Soojin (security) has standard evidence bundles; request ID: SEC-REQ-2027-011.

Next steps / timeline: 
- Today EOD: Contracts will complete first-pass redline comments and return a marked-up MSA highlighting items needing legal escalation (KPark).
- Tomorrow 10:00am PT: optional 30-minute redline sync if WaveLine wants to walk material edits (Ilan + Mira + KPark + DK).
- If changes are straightforward we will circulate an updated MSA + Order Form within 2 business days post-sync.

Marissa — can you confirm the billing contact email and whether WaveLine needs net-45 terms or standard net-30? Ilan flagged procurement cycles; we should capture preferred payment terms upfront.

For tracking: HubSpot deal WL-2027-011 updated with intake packet (Ilan to confirm signature name).

--
